scheduler.parallelism: Only independently ready new-file modules; no runtime jobs exist.
scheduler.integration: One integration owner for shared existing paths; exclusive path lease + dependency order; exact patch scope/reviewed artifact required.
scheduler.readiness: Dependencies require accepted integrated artifact and native readback receipts; unresolved spec digest/revision or external readiness fails closed.
scheduler.failure: Failed acceptance preserves receipt/history and blocks dependents; independent ready packages may continue.
scheduler.cutover: No writer adoption until snapshot/hash/epoch/revoke gates and authoritative readback; personal sources remain isolated.
